entries.german: Johann Graf von Wertheim, Philipp Graf von Hanau-Lichtenberg, Michel und Asmus Grafen von Wertheim verpflichten sich, den Ritter Georg von Rosenberg für die zu leistenden Dienste schadlos zu halten.
entries.english: Johann, Count of Wertheim, Philipp, Count of Hanau-Lichtenberg, and Michel and Asmus, Counts of Wertheim, undertake to indemnify Ritter Georg von Rosenberg for the services he is to perform.

facts.content: was promised indemnification by Johann, Count of Wertheim; Philipp, Count of Hanau-Lichtenberg; and Michel and Asmus, Counts of Wertheim, for the services he was to perform.
